messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High 5xx error rate observed for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (ELB request count spike). creating incident INC-2026-0342, paging oncall
maya: acked. oncall here, pulling metrics now.
chris: I see target-group tg-abc123 for api-alb-usw2 showing 60% unhealthy, 5xxs coming from a subset of targets. CloudWatch shows connection reset and 502 from ALB logs.
leo: routing/infra looking — no wholesale EC2 AZ failure reported, but we’re seeing increased connection resets between LB and targets in us-west-2b. VPC flow logs show spike in RSTs outbound from ENIs attached to the backend ASG.
sara: paging Support for customer impact — kevin, can you surface which customers hit errors?
kevin: support: ~18% of requests failing globally for hosted-api; majority from us-west-2 clients. high-volume customers: acme-corp, photo-app; both reporting API errors. open support threads linked.
maya: mitigation plan: 1) remove unhealthy targets from TG, 2) increase ALB capacity in other AZs in us-west-2, 3) start weighted Route53 failover to us-east-1 for latency-insensitive traffic. will coordinate.
chris: removing unhealthy targets now (manually deregistering 3 instances)
chris: ```bash
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-west-2:123456:targetgroup/tg-abc123/aaaa --targets Id=i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h
```
chris: targets deregistered, ALB drifting to healthy targets but still seeing some 502 spikes. investigating backend app errors and kernel logs.
leo: running tcpdump on eni-0bbccdde, seeing TCP RST pairs from the hypervisor side intermittently. reached out to AWS support case 1234567891 for networking in us-west-2b.
incident-bot: AWS advisory detected: potential regional networking degradation affecting ENI connectivity in us-west-2. adding to INC-2026-0342 timeline.
maya: we should enable Route53 weighted routing to shift 30% of traffic to us-east-1 now, TTL 60s. sara/nora: okay to route non-sensitive workloads?
nora: product: ok to route non-PII customer traffic. enable for public hosted-api only. keep private customer zones pinned.
chris: pushing Route53 change now (weight change).
chris: ```json
{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.com","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"us-east-1","Weight":30,"AliasTarget":{"HostedZoneId":"Z3ABCDEFG","DNSName":"dualstack-alb-use1-123456.us-east-1.elb.amazonaws.com","EvaluateTargetHealth":false}}]} }
```
chris: change submitted. Route53 change id: C123-4567890.
sara: monitoring error rate and latency as we shift traffic. asking CI to run a small sweep against /health and /v1/generate on new route.
kevin: support: informing impacted customers about partial outage and mitigation steps. posting status in status.redwood.com update draft.
maya: oncall handoff note: if this persists >2h, escalate to SRE lead. chris, can you take ownership for next 45m? I need to coordinate with customers.
chris: taking over. will stay on this thread.
leo: AWS replied on case — they see control-plane packet drops in us-west-2b affecting ENI detach/attach and some host-level networking. they recommend draining affected hosts and moving traffic. requesting capacity increase in other AZs.
chris: initiated ASG scale +2 in us-west-2a and us-west-2c, draining instances in 2b.
chris: ```bash
aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name backend-asg-usw2 --desired-capacity 18 --honor-cooldown
aws ec2 terminate-instances --instance-ids i-0bad2... (draining tagged for 2b)
```
incident-bot: NOTE: PagerDuty incident INC-2026-0342 assigned to chris, priority P1.
pagerduty: paging: chris (on-call) -> acknowledge required.
chris: acknowledged PD. monitoring.
sara: runbook check — if ELB health continues to oscillate after draining, we need to failover more traffic and update customer-facing limits. set eval to 50% weighted to us-east-1 if errors persist.
kevin: support: drafting message: "We are experiencing elevated error rates for hosted API in us-west-2. We are routing a portion of traffic to another region while AWS investigates. Some requests may see increased latency. We will update in 30 minutes." :warning:
nora: product: please attach list of impacted customers and any SLAs affected.
kevin: adding list, filing RC for billing exceptions for affected customers.
chris: after draining, target health stabilized to 98% on remaining instances; 5xx rate down from 18% to 6% overall, ~still higher than baseline. Route53 shift showing gradual reduction.
leo: AWS case update: root cause appears to be a networking agent on some hosts causing ENI flaps in 2b; mitigation: AWS replacing affected nodes and has scheduled host replacement. ETA 45-90m.
maya: good. chris please keep monitoring and transition to postmortem when resolved. I'll update status page and coordinate customer comms.
sara: oncall handoff at 1799006000 — chris -> sara for overnight monitoring. chris, please leave notes in INC ticket.
chris: handoff ack. notes: drained 5 hosts in 2b, scaled up in 2a/2c, Route53 weight 30% to use1, AWS case 1234567891.
kevin: support: posting initial status update now.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-2026-0342 | reduced customer impact, partial regional networking degradation in us-west-2. next update in 30m or on major change.
maya: closing initial paging loop. everyone please add any logs/commands to the incident timeline. thanks :thumbsup:
